programmes.d: To his regret, Rob ignores Laura's warning to be careful on the slopes during his first skiing excursion.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura, and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Rob plans to make himself scarce when he hears French heartthrob and old acquaintance, Jacques Savon, is Alan's guest star.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley.
President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service.
Norman Curtis breaks the Cannonball's throttle lever, threatening the success of the Shady Rest Hotel's annual jamboree.
Kate's intentions are mistaken when she tries to help Floyd Smoot regain his confience after being slighted by the woman he loves.
Kate is forced to peddle cologne when Uncle Joe buys a bunch of cases with the money meant for window screens.
Betty Jo must challenge the legendary Pixley Fats in the Annual Horeshoe Tournament.
Kate tries to teach Betty Jo how to make Hot Rhubarb after setting her up on a double date.
Bank robbers stay the night at Shady Rest hoping to intercept a bank shipment on the Cannonball.
Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets lose a game.
Kate hires Herby to work as an Assistant Manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position.
It's Survival Training for the platoon: two-man teams must rough it for five days. Thinking Gomer will bring down the platoon's rating, Sgt. Carter takes him for his partner.
Gomer and his fellow Marines are headed into town on day passes when one of them is stuck on guard duty.

While hitching a ride to town Gomer stops to help a stranded motorist, she takes him into town to meet her mother. A robber is holding up liquor stores while wearing a Marine's uniform at the same time.
A mix-up leads Carter to believe Gomer's dying.
Gomer's conned into signing a contract for dancing lessons.
Carter asks Gomer to take his place on a date.
Carter's adopted Korean daughter arrives, but she's not the little girl he remembers.
Carter tries for the Officer Candidate School.
Gomer tries to collect money for Carter's birthday.
Carter may have to use Gomer as an honor guard since he owns a blue dress uniform.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

When a gangster who passes as Oliver's doppelganger arrives in town with his wife and partner to hide out from the law, a rumor spreads that Oliver is a cheat. Oliver seeks to save his good name, and Lisa tries figure out which Oliver is Oliver!

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.
The unflappable Jim gets an unexpected jolt when a wrecking ball crashes through the wall of his condemned apartment. A disaster ensues when he is forced to move in with Louie.
The drivers bare their souls, recalling those moments in their lives when fate caused them to detour from the street of dreams down the alley to becoming a cabbie.
As Elaine nears a decision on her future, the cabbies reminisce about those glorious things that "might have been" had fate not sent them down that treacherous road to the Sunshine Cab Co.
Reverend Jim comes to the rescue when Alex is consumed by gambling fever after a lucky night in Atlantic City.
When Simka learns that Latka has been unfaithful, she is bound by tradition to do the same thing with one of Latka's fellow cabbies.
After Latka has an affair with a female cabbie, Simka must do the same with one of his co-workers.
Jeff ends up in serious trouble after he confesses to stealing from the garage to protect the real villain.
Alex dreams of a new career in show business when he takes a part-time job as an assistant to a Broadway producer.
Chip sees a ghost while trick-or-treating.
All of the Douglases fall in love at the same time.
Chip has no mother to provide a recipe for a contest.
Chip tries to join a club of older schoolmates.
